name: Asymptotic Analysis
description: Mathematical methods for analyzing algorithm efficiency as input size approaches infinity

name: Big O Notation
description: Upper bound on algorithm growth rate; expresses worst-case time complexity

name: Omega Notation
description: Lower bound on algorithm growth rate; expresses best-case time complexity

name: Theta Notation
description: Tight bound on algorithm growth rate; expresses average-case time complexity

name: Time Complexity
description: Analysis of how algorithm runtime grows with input size

name: Space Complexity
description: Analysis of how algorithm memory usage grows with input size

name: Divide and Conquer
description: Algorithm design paradigm: divide problem into subproblems, solve recursively, combine solutions

name: Merge Sort
description: Divide and conquer sorting algorithm with O(n log n) time complexity

name: Array
description: Contiguous collection of elements with constant-time access by index

name: Recursion
description: Function calling itself to solve smaller instances of the same problem

name: Maximum Profit Problem
description: Find optimal buy/sell dates in stock prices to maximize profit

name: Greedy Algorithm
description: Algorithm design paradigm: at each step, make locally optimal choice

name: Exchange Argument
description: Proof method for greedy algorithms: show any optimal solution can be transformed into greedy solution

name: Coin Change Problem
description: Find minimum number of coins to make a target sum

name: Activity Selection Problem
description: Select maximum number of non-overlapping activities with greedy approach

name: Dynamic Programming
description: Algorithm design paradigm: solve subproblems once, store results, reuse for larger problems

name: Memoization
description: Top-down dynamic programming: use recursion with caching of results

name: Fibonacci Sequence
description: Classic DP example: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2), natural recursive structure leads to exponential naive solution

name: Recursion Tree
description: Visual representation of recursive calls showing subproblem structure and computational overlaps

name: Minimum Vertex Cover on Trees
description: Find minimum set of vertices covering all edges; NP-hard in general, polynomial on trees with DP

name: Tree
description: Acyclic connected graph with hierarchical parent-child relationships

name: Graph
description: Vertices connected by edges; can be directed, undirected, weighted, or cyclic

name: Binary Search
description: Divide and conquer algorithm for finding element in sorted array in O(log n) time

name: Optimal Substructure
description: Property where optimal solution contains optimal solutions to subproblems; required for greedy and DP

name: Greedy Choice Property
description: Property where locally optimal choice leads to globally optimal solution

name: Bubble Sort
description: Simple sorting algorithm comparing adjacent elements; O(n²) time complexity

name: Bottom-Up Dynamic Programming
description: Iterative approach to DP: compute solutions starting from base cases, building up to larger problems

name: Subproblem
description: Smaller instance of the same problem; key concept in divide-and-conquer and dynamic programming

name: Mathematical Induction
description: Proof method: prove base case, then show if true for n-1 then true for n

name: Direct Proof
description: Proof method: assume input, derive output using logical steps and definitions
